description: This is a Java source file implementing a custom RestAssured filter named DemoModeFilter. The filter intercepts HTTP requests during testing or demo modes and returns simulated (mocked) responses for specific API endpoints, primarily to avoid real HTTP calls in demo mode. It handles endpoints like authentication validation and job title management, returning predefined or dynamic dummy data.

classes.name: DemoModeFilter
classes.description: A singleton class implementing the RestAssured Filter interface that provides request interception and mock responses during demo mode.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Main method that intercepts the HTTP request, checks if mock mode is enabled, and returns pre-defined responses based on request method and URI.
